limitations: Four MICs represent two clinical isolates tested against two drugs, not four isolates.
No susceptibility category inferred for the low voriconazole MIC; source R calls remain historical.
Clinical co-occurrence does not independently establish causality for one genotype component.
Imported label 1909 remains unresolved; clinical donor identity is not assigned to it.
No laboratory MICs, plate-assay MIC conversions, additional medium results or variant normalization.
No exact genome, strain TaxID, sequence equivalence or clinical ERG11 protein inferred.
All 217 source associations retained; 66 identifier-scope reviews, 151 not reviewed at this scope.
No protocols, constructs, sequences, new variants or resistance-enhancement designs exported.
No NCBI requests, terms review, outreach or source adoption. Whole-record reviews remain pending.

primary_reviews.note: The strain label denotes reference background, not the clinical donor JEY355 or a uniquely resolved tested derivative. locations: UniProtKB release 2026_03: P14263 entry 126, sequence version 2; EnsemblFungi cross-reference
primary_reviews.note: UniProtKB:P14263 and the retained gene_id identify a reference ERG11 locus, not the deposited clinical allele or tested derivative. Source notation, compound-specific phenotype and species are retained without coordinate normalization, subject reassignment or independent attribution of combined-genotype effects.

evidence.notes: Results: clinical susceptibility and CtERG3 sequence analysis; Table 3. The genotype and measured phenotype share the named clinical isolate. Laboratory functional evidence remains separate.

Release 2026_03, entry version 42, sequence version 1, inspected 2026-10-08. Paper-declared deposit KC676662 / AGK44786.1 has protein-specific JEY162 strain evidence in citation CI-DK7KGAGGARC54. That citation has no indexed PMID; linkage uses the declared accession and strain, not bibliography alone. A different reference's ATCC strain label is not transferred.
